[INT: 4]            : [Int] Set number of threads in likelihood calculation[default:4]
  --Seed               [INT: 12345]        : [Int] Random number seed[default:12345]
  --Epsilon            [FLT: 1.0e-08]      : [Double] Minimization procedure convergence threshold, usually a trade-off bettween accuracy and running time[default:1e-10]
  --OutputPileup       [FLG: OFF]          : [Bool] If output temp pileup file
  --Verbose            [FLG: OFF]          : [Bool] If print the progress of the method on the screen

Construction of SVD Auxiliary Files - Use these options when generating SVDPrefix files
  --RefVCF             [STR: Empty]        : [String] VCF file from which to extract reference panel's genotype matrix[Required if no SVD files available]

Pileup Options - Arguments for pileup info extraction
  --min-BQ             [INT: 13]           : [Int] skip bases with baseQ/BAQ smaller than min-BQ
  --min-MQ             [INT: 2]            : [Int] skip alignments with mapQ smaller than min-MQ
  --adjust-MQ          [INT: 40]           : [Int] adjust mapping quality; recommended:50, disable:0
  --max-depth          [INT: 8000]         : [Int] max per-file depth
  --no-orphans         [FLG: OFF]          : [Bool] do not use anomalous read pairs
  --incl-flags         [INT: 1040]         : [Int] required flags: skip reads with mask bits unset
  --excl-flags         [INT: 1796]         : [Int] filter flags: skip reads with mask bits set

Deprecated Options - These options still are available but not recommended
  --UDPath             [STR: Empty]        : [String] UD matrix file from SVD result of genotype matrix
  --MeanPath           [STR: Empty]        : [String] Mean matrix file of genotype matrix
  --BedPath            [STR: Empty]        : [String] Bed file for markers used in this analysis,1 based pos(chr	pos-1	pos	refAllele	altAllele)[Required]

preflight.verifybamID:
1055:rule verifybamID:
1056:    input:
1057:        bqsr_bam = f"{BQSR_DIR}/{{sample}}_{SCRIPT_VERSION}.bam",
1058:        bqsr_bam_bai = f"{BQSR_DIR}/{{sample}}_{SCRIPT_VERSION}.bam.bai"
1059:    output:
1060:        verify_ancestry = f"{VERIFYBAMID_DIR}/{{sample}}.Ancestry",
1061:        verify_selfsm =   f"{VERIFYBAMID_DIR}/{{sample}}.selfSM"
1062:    log:
1063:        out = f"{VERIFYBAMID_DIR}/{{sample}}_verifybamID.log",
1064:        err = f"{VERIFYBAMID_DIR}/{{sample}}_verifybamID.err"
1065:    params:
1066:        verify_out_prefix = f"{VERIFYBAMID_DIR}/{{sample}}"
1067:    benchmark:
1068:        f"{BENCHMARK_DIR}/{{sample}}.verifybamID.benchmark"
1069:    resources:
1070:        mem_mb=config["memory"]["mem-5g"]
1071:    threads:
1072:        config['threads']['verifybamid']
1073:    priority:
1074:        config["PRIORITY"]["verifybamid"]
1075:    run:
1076:        try:
1077:            shell("""
1078:                {VerifyBamID2} \
1079:                    --BamFile {input.bqsr_bam} \
1080:                    --Output {params.verify_out_prefix} \
1081:                    --Reference {REF} \
1082:                    --SVDPrefix {VerifyBamID2_SVD} \
1083:                    --NumThread {threads} 1> {log.err} 2> {log.out}
1084:                
1085:                exit_code=$?
1086:                # exit_code 출력
1087:                echo "[#status code] {rule} {wildcards.sample} $exit_code" >> {log.err}
1088:                # status code 검사
1089:                if [ "$exit_code" -ne 0 ];then
1090:                    echo "Error detected, status code is non-zero" >> {log.err}
1091:                    rm -rf {output.verify_ancestry} {output.verify_selfsm}
1092:                    exit 1
1093:                fi
1094:                
1095:                sha256sum {output.verify_selfsm} >  {output.verify_selfsm}.sha256sum
1096:                
1097:                ln -s {output.verify_selfsm} {ANALYSIS_DIR}/{wildcards.sample}/{wildcards.sample}.selfSM
1098:            """)   
1099:        except:
1100:            sample_id = {wildcards.sample}
1101:            step = {rule}
1102:            err_message = {log.err}
1103:            send_alarm(sample_id, step, err_message, INPUT_DIR)
